content:
alex: CI red on main after my lockfile regen earlier. failing test: tests/e2e/test_shard_allocation.py::test_shard_size
ci-bot: Build #1482 failed on ubuntu-22.04 — https://ci.internal.company/1482 (failed job: unit-linux)
maria: can you paste the traceback / top error?
alex: sure — pasted below:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for cryptography which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
# ... full log shows 'openssl/evp.h: No such file or directory' while building _openssl.c
```
suresh: that looks like cryptography compiling from source (no wheel). did the lock regen bump cryptography or change manylinux constraints?
alex: lockfile diff: cryptography 40.0.2 -> 41.0.0, and a transitive bump for cffi from 1.15.1 -> 1.17.0
jen: quick check — can you try `poetry lock --no-update` + `poetry install` locally? if it still pulls 41.0.0 we can repro.
maria: I'll try on mac and ubuntu docker to see environment differences. starting ubuntu container now.
infra-bot: triggered rerun for job unit-linux on build #1483
maria: repro'd in docker: pip is building cryptography wheel and fails on missing openssl headers. the CI image used to have a system lib installed; maybe image tag changed in the regen process.
suresh: ok two possible vectors: (A) lock regen updated a package that changed wheel availability (newer cryptography requires newer manylinux or binary change), or (B) our CI base image lost system deps. we should bisect the lockfile to find the exact transitive that introduced the change.
alex: uploaded old_lock.toml and new_lock.toml to /tmp/locks on the build host. i have a small helper: `scripts/lockfile-bisect --old /tmp/old_lock.toml --new /tmp/new_lock.toml --test "pytest tests/e2e/test_shard_allocation.py::test_shard_size -q"`
jen: can someone run that? i don't have the locks locally. if bisect narrows to cryptography itself, we can pin it as an emergency revert.
maria: running bisect now (doing iterative installs, will take a few minutes).
maria: bisect output -> culprit transitive: `pyopenssl` bumped from 23.0 -> 24.0 which pulled in a cryptography feature requiring manylinux2014 wheels that our image doesn't provide.
suresh: nice find. two short fixes: pin pyopenssl to 23.x in constraints, or update the CI image to include the newer manylinux/binary support (or add libssl-dev).
alex: i'll open a tiny revert PR that pins pyopenssl back to 23.* so main gets green quickly. then follow up task to update images.
jen: +1, revert first. add a follow-up issue to update the base image and verify cryptography wheels on all runners.
maria: rerun infra job #1483 finished and is green (infra-bot). local docker still needs image fix but main is unblocked. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks all — I'll post the revert PR link in this thread when ready.
ci-bot: Revert PR opened: https://git.internal.company/r/redwood/infra/pulls/2325 — CI on that PR passes.
alex: PR merged. filing follow-up: GH issue #482 "update CI base images to support cryptography 41+ wheels / add libssl-dev" and assigning to infra.
suresh: reassign to infra-image owners, they should scope change to minimal.
jen: sounds good. thanks for the quick triage everyone.
alex: closing thread for now, will reopen if bisect shows anything else. :wave:
